papers.markingGuideNote: The scheme awards attempt marks of 2 for a 5-mark step. Deduct 3 for a mathematical error, or 1 for a numerical slip or minor misreading. A serious error that oversimplifies the task receives attempt marks only. Valid alternative methods are accepted. Do not deduct an error twice.
papers.boundaryReview: Q2(b)(i) magnitude and direction share a single final 5-mark placement after a 5-mark vector calculation, and remain one task. Q3(a)(i) the two angles share the final 5-mark placement; Q3(a)(ii) the difference in flight times is one 5-mark task. Q3(b)(ii) includes the unnumbered pre-impact velocity calculations above its printed part marker, without inventing additional marks. Q8(b)(i) has five 5-mark placements (25), and (ii) one 5-mark placement. Q10(b)(ii) is one 5-mark task; its integral is a suggested method and the scheme uses an equivalent spatial integration. The final fraction 10/99 was checked in an enlarged original crop. No finite answer choices occur inside tasks.
